_comment: EXAMPLE A2A exposure. Copy/edit and run scripts/provision-foundry-a2a.py to print the APIM-fronted consumer URL, the enable + APIM-front commands, and an agents.json stub. The APIM front reuses the toolbox bridge pattern: APIM injects the Foundry managed-identity bearer for https://ai.azure.com so callers present only the APIM subscription key. Nothing here changes the deploy; A2A is preview.
description: Remote Foundry agent that runs the research-brief routine; delegated to over A2A, gated on APIM auth.
